stem: A toddler has sudden cough while eating, persistent unilateral wheeze and unilateral hyperinflation on chest x-ray. Symptoms do not improve with salbutamol. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanation: Sudden cough or choking followed by persistent unilateral wheeze or hyperinflation is strongly suggestive of an inhaled foreign body, especially when bronchodilator therapy does not help.
